clue.text: Women carrying weapons got more affectionate

clue.text: Whisky area and island

clue.text: Deer's popular — what's the ammunition?

clue.text: Part of Australia unpopular with defender

explanation.definitionFit: To pass over a subject quickly is idiomatic for hardly mentioning it; literally, painting shiny finish on an undercoat.

clue.text: Finds fault with fools eating cream

explanation.definitionFit: To nitpick is to criticise petty details, which is finding fault.

clue.text: Badly hit trader is not very good

indicators.note: badly says the letters of the next words are jumbled and must be reordered

explanation.definitionFit: Obsolete means out of date, no longer in use, so it matches dated.

clue.text: Terrible verbosity — not so! Quite the opposite

clue.text: Bottles links supporting European politician

clue.text: Jokingly said 'Swallow'

clue.text: How the man at the back speaks?
